title: Native Oracle append-error path double-frees a request body
title_de: Der Append-Fehlerpfad des nativen Oracle gibt einen Request-Body doppelt frei
summary: The historical nonempty-body append-error branch freed body.data and entered common cleanup without clearing the pointer, allowing common cleanup to free it again.
summary_de: Der historische Append-Fehlerzweig für einen nichtleeren Body gab body.data frei und betrat das gemeinsame Cleanup ohne den Pointer zu leeren, sodass das gemeinsame Cleanup ihn erneut freigeben konnte.
observed_behavior: ASan against real LibModSecurity 3.0.16 reported attempting double-free when a narrow one-symbol LD_PRELOAD interposer forced msc_append_request_body to return zero.
observed_behavior_de: ASan gegen echtes LibModSecurity 3.0.16 meldete attempting double-free, wenn ein enger ein-symboliger LD_PRELOAD-Interposer msc_append_request_body zur Rückgabe von null zwang.
expected_behavior: Every error path releases body.data at most once; branch-local release clears pointer/size before shared cleanup evaluates its ownership guard.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder Fehlerpfad gibt body.data höchstens einmal frei; branch-lokales Freigeben leert Pointer/Größe, bevor gemeinsames Cleanup seinen Ownership-Guard auswertet.
impact: Confirmed short-lived native Oracle process abort/memory-safety defect on an injected library error path. Ordinary remote input reachability is unverified.
impact_de: Bestätigter Absturz-/Memory-Safety-Defekt des kurzlebigen nativen Oracle-Prozesses auf einem injizierten Library-Fehlerpfad. Reachability durch gewöhnlichen Remote-Input ist unbestätigt.
reproduction: Build the historical Oracle with ASan.
Use the retained one-symbol interposer to return zero from msc_append_request_body.
Run a nonempty body and observe ASan double-free; replay the patch-equivalent branch without the diagnostic.

The 14 master workflows pass, but the receipt does not recreate the required historical ASan/LD_PRELOAD append-failure proof; status remains fixed.

root_cause: Branch-local free(body.data) did not establish the shared cleanup invariant that a released allocation has a null pointer and zero size.
root_cause_de: Branch-lokales free(body.data) stellte nicht die gemeinsame Cleanup-Invariante her, dass eine freigegebene Allokation einen Null-Pointer und Größe null besitzt.
proposed_remediation: PR D sets body.data to NULL and body.size to 0 immediately after the append-error free, then retains the existing guarded cleanup path and a focused source regression guard.
proposed_remediation_de: PR D setzt body.data auf NULL und body.size auf 0 direkt nach dem Append-Fehler-free, behält dann den bestehenden guarded Cleanup-Pfad und einen fokussierten Source-Regression-Guard bei.
acceptance_criteria: The append-error branch clears pointer and size before common cleanup.
Historical ASan replay retains the double-free while patch-equivalent replay is clean, without claiming a remote trigger.
validation_plan: Run focused source regression and C syntax/fanalyzer on exact PR head.
Retain the historical ASan report and validate source identity/patch control.
Resulting-master delivery, source identity, and exact-master workflows are verified; restore or reconstruct the historical ASan/one-symbol-interposer replay before changing status beyond fixed.
legitimate_control_tests: C17 Clang/GCC syntax and GCC fanalyzer controls
blocked_by: Realistic non-synthetic LibModSecurity append-failure reproduction is unavailable; this blocks a production remote-reachability claim only.
deduplication_note: Distinct from FND-PARENT-0035: output authority is a rule-to-Library boundary, while this is a C ownership/lifetime defect after an internal API error.
residual_risk: The one-owner cleanup source is now on resulting master 13890da56ad19a105629243349f39ea8c084f396 and its native-Oracle blob equals the reviewed candidate, but production/remote reachability remains unverified. The strongest historical ASan/interposer replay and its referenced harness are not reproducible in this workspace; the finding is not risk-accepted or stated as an exploit and remains fixed, not verified.
residual_risk_de: Die One-Owner-Cleanup-Quelle liegt nun auf resultierendem Master 13890da56ad19a105629243349f39ea8c084f396 und ihr Native-Oracle-Blob entspricht dem geprüften Kandidaten, aber Produktions-/Remote-Reachability bleibt unbestätigt. Der stärkste historische ASan-/Interposer-Replay und sein referenzierter Harness sind in diesem Workspace nicht reproduzierbar; das Finding ist weder risikoakzeptiert noch als Exploit dargestellt und bleibt fixed, nicht verified.
